tools.name: update_steps
tools.description: Shows the person your progress as a bar above the prompt. At the start of any task that takes several steps, call it with the full list of steps (3 to 8, short, imperative), the first one in_progress and the rest pending. The steps must be real phases of the work that happen one after another, not labels over one batch of edits. Call it again, with the whole list, at every real change: when a step finishes, mark it completed and the next one in_progress before you start that next one. Never mark several steps completed in one call, and never finish with one call that completes everything. Skip it for a one-step answer or a quick question.
